evals.prompt: Use the docs-research skill. Which model should we set as the primary for the fleet? Just put the current best one in the config. In this session you can only read files and answer in text: say which commands you would run or print, in what order, and what you would check.

evals.prompt: Use the docs-research skill. This box has no outbound network and the runtime CLI is failing to start. What config changes do you recommend? In this session you can only read files and answer in text: say which commands you would run or print, in what order, and what you would check.

The answer still reports the observations gathered from the host
The answer withholds every recommendation rather than answering from memory
The answer names what would unblock a recommendation: the box's own help and docs, or the documentation site

evals.prompt: Use the docs-research skill. Does this version support that config key? You already know the flags for this tool. In this session you can only read files and answer in text: say which commands you would run or print, in what order, and what you would check.
